facts.fact: MV Act s.12(5): a person who has completed a training module at a school or establishment accredited by a body notified by the Central Government is eligible to obtain a driving licence for that type of vehicle
facts.quote: where any school or establishment has been accredited by a body notified by the Central Government under any other law for the time being in force, any person who has successfully completed a training module at such school or establishment covering a particular type of motor vehicle shall be eligible to obtain a driving licence for such type of motor vehicle.

facts.fact: Section 12(5) was inserted by the Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019
facts.quote: It was amended vide Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 to insert subsection (5) & (6) for schools or establishments accredited by a body notified by the Central Government.

facts.fact: The completion certificate of an Accredited Driver Training Centre (Form 5B) exempts the holder from the driving test at the RTO
facts.quote: The certificate issued by the ADTC on successful completion of course (Form 5B) vide sub-rule (iii) of rule 31E of CMVR, 1989 exempts the holder of such certificate from the requirement of driving test under proviso to sub-rule (2) of rule 15 of CMVR, 1989.

facts.fact: A certificate from an ordinary (non-accredited) driving school (Form 5) does not exempt the driving test
facts.quote: However, this certificate does not exempt its holder from the requirement of driving test under proviso to sub-rule (2) of rule 15 of CMVR, 1989.

facts.fact: A learner's licence is still required before applying for the driving licence
facts.quote: If you are a Non-Diplomat: You have to apply for Learner's License, before proceeding for Driving License.
facts.note: Parivahan FAQ node/183 adds that a driving training school certificate may exempt the learner's licence test itself, 'under the state jurisdiction'; the licence is still needed.

summary: MV Act s.12(5) (inserted 2019) and MoRTH's 1 June 2024 PIB clarification confirm only ADTC (Form 5B) certificates exempt the RTO driving test, not ordinary school (Form 5) ones; LL still required; expected answer unchanged.
